publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for asset metadata, upload-intent, same-origin byte upload, completion, content-read, delete, and cleanup routes.
Public asset seam for future consuming features to create upload intents, accept same-origin bytes, validate, read, and link assets without importing storage or persistence internals.
Public error base class for consuming feature routers that surface asset validation failures through their route family.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing asset lifecycle, upload-intent binding, or storage-key immutability semantics can make uploaded bytes usable without the approved verification path.
Changing same-origin private content-read behavior can leak storage authority or bypass asset-native authorization.
Changing validation seam semantics can let consuming features replace entity authorization with generic asset ownership.
